jobs.title: TUM Project Study: Earned LinkedIn Media for Enterprise
jobs.description: About us Mediacharge GmbH is a Munich-based, internationally oriented marketing agency with ten years of experience in cutting-edge marketing for international enterprises. Operating in 14 languages, we combine first-tier strategic consulting with hands-on operational excellence, measured against business results. Project description (TUM Project) This project study explores what turns an enterprise’s own people into LinkedIn voices that measurably drive Sales, Recruiting or Employer Brand. Using Mediacharge and its enterprise clients as the case environment, it examines how earned media, meaning content published by real people rather than paid brand channels, creates business impact. The project combines a business strategy perspective - objectives, the right people and measurable outcomes - with a content and platform perspective, focusing on talent profiles, content types, success patterns and the time it takes to build an effective voice. Objectives of the project study to classify enterprise objectives for earned LinkedIn media (Sales, Recruiting, Employer Brand), to identify which talent profiles and content types work best for each objective, to derive success patterns, including what it takes and how long it takes to see results, to develop one strategy blueprint per objective and an impact model to measure business effect. jobs.description: Make sure every restaurant on SOUS grows its revenue, across Uber Eats, Just Eat Takeaway and its own direct ordering channel. Full-time About SOUS SOUS exists to give independent restaurants the same acquisition-to-retention infrastructure that only chains and delivery platforms could previously afford. We build it as one connected data layer, replacing the fragmented stack most restaurants run today: a listings tool here, a separate storefront there, and no CRM at all. Spotlight owns discovery, as search shifts from Google links to AI assistants recommending where to eat. Commerce owns the transaction and, critically, the guest relationship that marketplaces have been extracting for a decade. Every order through that owned channel generates data that sharpens the next cycle of visibility, personalisation and retention, compounding in the restaurant's favour instead of the platform's. Our long-term bet is simple. As AI becomes the default interface for "where should I eat", the restaurants that own their guest data and their presence in that layer will keep the margin, and the ones still renting both from marketplaces will not. We are building the infrastructure to make the first outcome the default, not the exception. We are a team of 27, working from our headquarters on the Vijzelstraat in Amsterdam city centre, and we are growing fast across the Netherlands, Germany and South Africa. About the role Our promise to restaurants is simple: SOUS helps you grow. That means more

Unser Portfolio umfasst eine breite Palette innovativer Systeme, die eine zuverlässige Produkthandhabung, eine stabile Linienleistung sowie eine effiziente Verbindung zwischen Verarbeitungs- und Verpackungsprozessen gewährleisten. Wir sind bestrebt, unser Angebot und unsere Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, um den sich wandelnden Anforderungen unserer Kunden gerecht zu werden. jobs.title: AI Trainer - Video Annotation
jobs.description: AI Trainer - Video Annotation Remote | Independent Contractor Prove your skills. Get certified. Robotics AI is advancing rapidly, and high-quality video data helps intelligent systems better understand the world around them. We are inviting detail-oriented professionals to complete our certification process for potential robotics AI projects. ▌ What you will do As part of the certification process, you will demonstrate your ability to: Annotate short video clips by identifying objects, actions and events. Evaluate video quality, relevance and accuracy against established guidelines. Assess the clarity and plausibility of movements. Apply instructions consistently and identify potential quality issues. ▌ What you bring Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking. Strong written English and the ability to follow detailed instructions independently. A commitment to accuracy and consistency. No previous AI or robotics experience required. ▌ What the work looks like You may review short videos and be asked to tag objects or actions, rate video clarity or camera angles on a 1 to 10 scale, or assess whether movements are clearly visible and plausible. Please note: We currently have three projects open, and completing the certification process will allow us to evaluate which project may be the best fit for you.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go

For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time. Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!
